players.product: Platinum Pro single-molecule protein sequencer and Proteus platform

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K fiscal 2025 results: total revenue $2,436 thousand (-20.3% from $3,058 thousand), of which product $2,286 thousand (-21.8%) and service $150 thousand (+12.8%); gross profit margin 47.3% (52.3% in 2024); research and development $53,759 thousand; operating expenses included $13,577 thousand of lease termination expense and $5,162 thousand of legal settlement expense; net loss $101,339 thousand. International sales were $1,737 thousand and domestic sales $699 thousand. Capital expenditures were $2.5 million in 2025 and were anticipated at approximately $5.0 million for 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 revenue $2,436 thousand (-20.3%); gross margin 47.3%; net loss $101,339 thousand; 2026 capex approximately $5.0 million

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K manufacturing and supply: Quantum-Si designs its instruments, which have historically been manufactured by a third-party contract manufacturing partner at facilities in the United States and internationally; third-party foundries produce the silicon wafers for its semiconductor chips, which it packages and tests internally, with a semiconductor chip manufacturing location in Garnet Valley, Pennsylvania; consumables are made in San Diego, California, Garnet Valley and internationally. Wafers and other components come from single-source suppliers, and most contract-manufacturer contracts do not commit them to carry inventory. In August 2025 it paid $1.8 million to settle claims by the former contract manufacturer of its Platinum and Carbon instruments, which it had told in April 2023 it would transition away from.
quarterly_data.figure: $1.8 million settlement with the former contract manufacturer
